strings.settings.theme.label: Theme
strings.settings.theme.help: Follows your OS light/dark setting when set to System.
strings.settings.language.label: Language
strings.settings.language.help: App UI language. Changes apply immediately.
strings.settings.reduce_transparency.label: Reduce transparency
strings.settings.reduce_transparency.help: Uses opaque compact navigation and headers instead of backdrop blur.
strings.settings.call_diagnostics.label: Call diagnostics
strings.settings.call_diagnostics.help: Shows technical call-path details during calls (also enabled by --debug).
strings.settings.profile.no_peer_id: No Peer ID yet — register on the network first.
strings.settings.notifications.help: Off silences OS banners and unregisters push; inbox still syncs in the background.
strings.settings.llm.brief_key_auto: Issued automatically when you register in Profile.
strings.settings.llm.preset_help: Preset defaults apply when saved. Leave API key blank to keep the existing key.
strings.settings.integrations.mcp_help: Custom MCP servers (stdio on desktop; URL on mobile).
strings.settings.network.help_network_hint: When on, this desktop can listen for peers (Node). Takes effect after unlock or app restart.
strings.settings.network.connection.title: Connection
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_un: Reachability has not been measured yet.
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_ch: Testing whether peers can connect to you…
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_re: Others can connect to this device directly.
Reachable via IPv6 — others can connect directly.
Router port mapping succeeded — testing inbound…
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_ou: You can reach the network, but inbound connections may need relay.
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_bl: Could not reach the network seed — check firewall or network.
strings.settings.network.help.outbound_only: Likely behind a home router: forward the WAN port shown under Listen address to this PC, then test again. CGNAT or ISP blocks may still prevent inbound.
strings.settings.network.help.blocked: Allow PP (pp-browser) in your OS firewall or try another network. VPNs can block peer connections.
strings.settings.network.help.reachable: Direct connections to you should work. Thank you for helping the network.
strings.settings.network.help.skip_relay: You can skip port forwarding — messaging still works via relay.
strings.settings.network.banner_hint: Direct connections may use relay until inbound works. See Me → Network.
strings.settings.network.circuit_relay_hint: Let other people reach each other through this computer.
strings.settings.network.media_relay_hint: Forward call audio/video for others (you can't listen in).
strings.settings.network.dht_hint: Help peers find each other on the mesh. Uses extra bandwidth when enabled.
strings.settings.network.prefer_contacts_hint: Prefer your contacts when connecting, and when helping. Turn off to help the wider network too.
strings.settings.network.direct_connections.help: Who may connect to this device directly, and so learn its IP address. Everyone else reaches you through a relay; blocked people never connect directly.
strings.settings.network.trusted_relays.help: Relays see where both ends connect from. When on, only the organization’s servers and your Friendly contacts’ nodes relay for you; connections may be slower or fail more often.
strings.settings.security.default_hint: Your keys use the app default. Change it below for stronger protection.
strings.settings.security.not_setup_hint: Key protection is created when you first use secure messaging or register on the network.
strings.settings.security.group_invites.help: Controls who can invite you to group chats. Separate from direct messages.
strings.settings.security.calls.help: Calls from anyone else never ring, and the caller is not told. Blocked people can never call.
strings.settings.security.tool_permissions.help: When the assistant wants to change contacts, chats, or identity, it asks in chat. Always allow / Never are remembered here.
strings.settings.security.tool_permissions.reset: Clear saved Always allow and Never decisions. The assistant will ask again before changing your data.
strings.settings.security.clear_undelivered.help: Removes old undelivered delivery-queue items from the relay. Does not clear local chat history.
strings.settings.security.clear_undelivered_conf: This deletes undelivered relay inbox items older than 7 days. Local chat history on this device is not deleted.
strings.settings.security.clear_undelivered.not_: Unlock and register before clearing the delivery queue.
strings.settings.security.link_device.help: Copy a 15-minute payload on this device. On the new install, choose I already have an account when asked. Private Secure chats are not copied.
strings.settings.security.link_device.send_hint: Linked devices share this account. Send from one device at a time for now; all linked devices can receive.
strings.settings.security.link_device.reset_hint: Already using this device as a different account? Reset this profile in Storage first.
strings.settings.security.link_device.export_con: Copies a 15-minute payload with your account keys and shared secret. Anyone with it can add a device. Paste it on the new device.
strings.settings.security.link_device.not_ready: Unlock your profile before linking a device.
strings.settings.security.crash_reports.label: Send crash reports
strings.settings.security.crash_reports.help: Off by default. When on, a compact crash note (version, signal, stack fingerprint, recent log component tags — no chat content) may upload to the PP network on the next launch.
strings.settings.security.pin_both_required: Current and new PIN are required
strings.settings.security.unlock_to_change: Unlock your profile to change the PIN.
strings.settings.storage.reset_confirm_message: This permanently deletes local data for this profile (contacts, chats, keys). You cannot undo this. After reset, you can start new or join an account you already use.
strings.settings.storage.reset_confirm_check: I understand this cannot be undone
strings.settings.storage.attachment_policy.label: Media downloads
strings.settings.storage.attachment_policy.help: Smart auto-downloads images and small files (≤ 4 MiB). Larger files need a tap unless you choose Always auto.
strings.settings.storage.clear_attachments_confi: Removes saved attachment files on this device. Chat messages stay; auto-download will not bring them back unless you tap Download again.
strings.settings.reset_defaults_confirm_message: This restores this section's settings to their defaults.
strings.pin.unlock_message: Enter your PIN to unlock secure data.
strings.pin.create_message: Choose a PIN to protect your keys and identity on this device.
strings.pin.chooser_message: Set a PIN, or continue with the app default for now.
strings.pin.identity_fork_message: Start new, or join an account you already use on another device.
strings.pin.link_chooser_message: This device's PIN wraps the shared keys. It can differ from your other device.
strings.pin.link_create_message: Choose a PIN to protect the shared keys on this device.
strings.pin.link_paste_message: Paste the payload copied from your other device. It expires in 15 minutes.
strings.contacts.title: Contacts
strings.contacts.empty_hint: No contacts yet. Tap + to add one, find people on the network, or ask the assistant.
strings.contacts.actions_hint: Secure uses a shared key. Public chat is encrypted without a private shared key.
strings.contacts.hint.add_id: Add a relay ID, or a peer ID with multiaddr, to message.
strings.contacts.hint.not_dialable: Add a relay ID or multiaddr, or connect on the same network so this PeerId becomes dialable.
strings.contacts.hint.relay_pinned: Relay messaging available. Add a multiaddr for a pinned direct link.
strings.contacts.hint.direct_no_relay: Add a multiaddr for direct messaging without relay.
strings.contacts.hint.relay_direct: Relay messaging available. Add a multiaddr for a direct link.
strings.contacts.remove_confirm_body: Remove {name} from contacts? Conversations stay on this device. You can add them again later from Find.
strings.people_picker.title: New conversation
strings.people_picker.empty: No messageable contacts yet. Add contacts first.
strings.people_picker.empty_group_call: No other members in this group yet.
strings.people_picker.err.too_many: Too many invitees for this call
strings.chat.permission.intro: I need your permission before changing contacts, chats, or identity settings.
strings.chat.permission.prompt_one: Allow the assistant to run this action that can change your data?
strings.chat.permission.prompt_one_named: Allow the assistant to run this action that can change your data ({names})?
strings.chat.permission.prompt_many: Allow the assistant to run these actions that can change your data?
strings.chat.permission.prompt_many_named: Allow the assistant to run these actions that can change your data ({names})?
strings.chat.permission.stale: That permission prompt is no longer active. Ask again if you still want this.
strings.chat.permission.stale_reason: That permission prompt is no longer active ({reason}). Ask again if you still want this.
strings.chat.permission.not_ready: Assistant is not ready for permission decisions.
strings.chat.ai_thread.subtitle: AI assistant
strings.chat.direct.placeholder: Message… · @ai asks the assistant (only your question is sent)
strings.chat.direct.placeholder_secure: Secure message… · @ai asks the assistant (only your question is sent)
strings.chat.share_ai.title: Share with the other person?
strings.chat.share_ai.body_reply: The AI reply will be sent on this encrypted thread. @ai sends only your question to the assistant, never this conversation.
strings.chat.share_ai.body_full: Your question and the AI reply will be sent on this encrypted thread. @ai sends only your question to the assistant, never this conversation.
strings.chat.share_ai.dont_ask: Don't ask again for this conversation
strings.chat.empty_body: Ask anything, or open Sessions to continue a thread.
strings.chat.delete_confirm_ai: Delete this chat? Its messages will be removed.
strings.chat.delete_confirm: Delete this chat? Its messages are removed from this device; the other person's are not affected.
strings.chat.group.leave_confirm: Leave this group? You’ll stop receiving messages, and your copy of the chat will be removed from this device.
strings.chat.group.leave_owner_confirm: Leave this group? Choose who becomes the new owner. Your copy of the chat will be removed from this device.
strings.chat.group.dismiss_confirm: Dismiss this group on this device? If nobody else is reachable, nothing is sent to peers.
strings.chat.group.rename_for_everyone_prompt: Shared group name for all members
strings.chat.group.remove_member_confirm: Remove {name} from this group? Others will be notified.
strings.chat.group.owner_only: Only the owner can do that — see the note in the chat
strings.chat.open_link_skip: Don't ask again until PP restarts
strings.chat.attachment.open_confirm_body: This file will open in another app on your device.
strings.chat.image.not_supported: Only PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or HEIC images are supported.
strings.chat.image.too_large: This image is too large. Try a smaller one.
strings.chat.link.banner.unreachable: Can't reach them right now — they may be offline. PP will keep trying.
strings.chat.link.banner.no_address: This contact has no usable connection details. Ask them to share their contact again.
strings.blob.quota.title: Relay upload space full
strings.chat.device_lock.confirm_body: New messages will stay on this install. Older history remains on your other devices. This is not Private or Secure.
strings.chat.device_lock.locked_out_body: This chat continues on another device. You can still read older messages here.
strings.chat.banner.gap: Some messages from your peer may be missing. Peer sync does not resend your unsent messages.
strings.chat.banner.integrity: Message integrity issue detected. Sending and sync are paused. Rotate the encryption key and share the bundle with your contact, or pause only.
strings.chat.banner.psk_share: Share your encryption key with this contact out of band, then verify the fingerprint before sending.
strings.chat.banner.psk_compare: Compare this fingerprint with your contact, then confirm verification before sending.
strings.chat.banner.import_placeholder: Paste raw base64 key or pp-browser-psk-bundle-v1 JSON
strings.chat.banner.older_hint: Older messages may be available from your peer.
strings.chat.error.message_too_long: Message is too long to send.
strings.chat.clear_history.body: Only the messages on this device are removed; the chat stays in your list. The other person's messages are not affected. Clear it?
strings.chat.clear_history.body_ai: All messages in this chat are removed; the chat stays in your list. Clear it?
strings.chat.clear_history.body_secure: Messages not sent yet are cancelled.
strings.chat.forget_memory.title: Forget what AI learned?
strings.chat.forget_memory.body: Delete the durable conversation summary? Your message transcript stays on this device.
strings.chat.fork_group.title: Start a new group?
strings.chat.fork_group.body: This creates a new group with a fresh history. People who are still reachable can be invited again.
strings.chat.react.title: React
strings.chat.react.prompt: Pick an emoji (use the keyboard emoji key on mobile).
strings.chat.share.no_friends: No chats to share to yet.
strings.chat.quote.not_found: The quoted message is not in the loaded part of this chat.
strings.chat.menu.delete_confirm: It is removed from this device only. The other side keeps their copy.
strings.chat.hint.brief_register: Register your identity in Me → Profile to use Brief assistant (or switch to Cloud/Ollama).
strings.chat.hint.brief_free_tier: Using Brief free tier — register in Me → Profile for higher limits.
strings.chat.hint.brief_unavailable: Brief free tier unavailable right now — try again later, or register in Me → Profile.
strings.chat.hint.brief_unavailable_temp: Brief free tier is temporarily unavailable — try again later.
strings.chat.hint.brief_key_save_failed: Couldn't save Brief free-tier key — try again later.
strings.chat.hint.mock_replies: Using mock replies — LLM is not configured.
strings.chat.hint.api_key_needed: Add your API key in Me → Assistant to enable the assistant.
strings.chat.hint.registration_expires: Network registration expires soon — renew in Me → Profile
strings.chat.sync.gap_none: No missing messages found for this gap.
strings.chat.psk.new_secure_body: This bumps the session epoch and cancels unsent messages from the previous epoch. Your saved transcript stays on this device.
strings.chat.psk.paused: Messaging paused until you rotate the encryption key.
strings.chat.psk.paste_first: Paste a key or bundle first.
strings.chat.psk.key_installed: Encryption key installed. Verify the fingerprint before sending.
strings.chat.psk.verify_body: Only confirm after you compared this fingerprint with your contact out of band.
strings.chat.psk.verify_checkbox: I've verified this fingerprint with my contact
strings.chat.psk.verified: Encryption key verified. You can send secure messages.
strings.chat.psk.rotate_body: This generates a new key, bumps the session epoch, and cancels unsent messages from the previous epoch. Share the exported bundle with your contact out of band.
strings.chat.psk.rotated_body: The pp-browser-psk-bundle-v1 JSON was copied to your clipboard. Send it to your contact securely.
strings.chat.psk.rotated: Encryption key rotated. Share the bundle with your contact.
strings.call.status.ended_by_peer_unknown: The other side ended the call
strings.call.status.declined_by_peer_unknown: The other side declined the call
strings.call.hint.group_media: Group call needs call hosting help. Enable Help host calls on a computer that's helping the network, or an org node, then retry.
strings.call.hint.switching_media_path: Everyone will reconnect on the new path.
strings.call.hint.looking_for_another_path: Your device couldn't reach the current path.
strings.call.hint.seed_unreachable: Network restricted — if a VPN is on, turn it off first.
strings.call.hint.peer_unreachable: Couldn't reach the other person. Try again in a moment.
strings.call.error.no_media_relay_hop: No call host available — join from a computer with Help host calls on, or start the group call from that computer, then retry.
strings.call.error.local_media_relay_unavailable: This device can't host group media. Use a computer with Help host calls on, or an org node.
strings.call.error.media_key_timeout: Couldn't finish connecting — call key never arrived. Retry the call, or check that both devices are online.
strings.call.error.video_not_allowed: Video isn't allowed for this call.
strings.call.ring.accept_charge_disabled_hint: Payment isn't available yet — accept free, or decline.
strings.call.ring.callback_hint: {caller} is calling you back. Answering ends your outgoing call.
strings.call.ring.conflict_hint: Answering will end your current call with {peer}.
strings.call.pricing.offer: They offered {amount} {currency} to start this conversation
strings.call.error.payment_unavailable: Payment isn't available yet — you can't start a paid conversation.
strings.call.error.payment_unavailable_media: Available call hosts require payment that isn't set up yet.
strings.call.notify.title: Incoming call
strings.call.action.speaker: Speaker
strings.call.details.title: Call details
strings.call.error.wrong_thread_type: Voice and video calls are available in direct and group chats
strings.call.error.select_person: Select at least one person to call
strings.call.error.hop_unreachable_guest: Couldn't join this group call — no shared media path to the others. Try again on the same network, or when a desktop is on the call.
strings.call.error.hop_unreachable_owner: Couldn't connect {name} to this call — no shared media path.
strings.hints.network.local_macos: On Mac, allow Local Network for {product} in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
strings.hints.network.local_ios: Allow microphone and local network access for {product} in Settings.
strings.hints.network.firewall_windows: Check Windows microphone privacy and that the firewall allows {product}.
strings.hints.network.lan_linux: Check both devices are on the same network and UDP is not blocked.
strings.hints.mic_blocked: Microphone access looks blocked — enable it in system privacy settings.

strings.errors.blob.quota_nothing_to_delete: Relay storage is full and there is nothing safe to remove remotely
strings.settings.storage.library.title: Files library
strings.settings.storage.library.help: Local CAS objects for this profile. Private stays encrypted; Share publicly… makes a clear public copy (Kept).
strings.settings.storage.library.share_confirm_m: Creates a clear public copy of this file in your library (Kept). Anyone with the content id may fetch it once provide is enabled.
strings.settings.storage.library.unpublish_confi: Stops keeping this public file (moves to Cache). Bytes may remain until cleared.
strings.settings.storage.library.fetch_tip_messa: Paste a pp-cas:v1:… tip or 64-hex content id.
strings.settings.storage.library.fetch_tip_peer_: Relay user id of a peer that still Keeps this public object.
strings.settings.storage.reset_warning: Reset deletes chats, contacts, keys, and PIN for this profile. Machine settings are kept.

strings.settings.registration.renewed: Registration renewed — Brief API key updated

strings.people.result.found_many_partial: Found {count} people — showing the first {shown}. Open the panel to pick who you mean.
strings.feed.result.title: Latest briefs
strings.people.result.no_people: No people found. Try a different name, nickname, or account id.
